title: Session
description: Represents an active authentication session within the Workday tenant, including details about the signon event, device, and session lifetime.

systemAccount.description: The system account or username associated with the session

sessionEnd.description: Timestamp when the session ended or will expire

ipAddress.description: IP address from which the signon originated

authenticationType.description: Authentication method used for the signon such as SAML, password, or OAuth

browserType.description: Browser type used for the signon

deviceType.description: Device type from which the signon was made

deviceIsTrusted.description: Whether the device is registered as a trusted device

isDeviceManaged.description: Whether the device is managed by the organization

isFailed.description: Whether the signon attempt was unsuccessful

multiFactorType.description: Multi-factor authentication type used if applicable
